entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It works fine. It's just... not for me. I feel awful about it, but I really need the money back. Things are a bit tight right now.
I understand. Let me pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've had it for a little over a month. I'm just so worried it's **too late**. I know with wearable items, there are often rules about **hygiene** and things like that.

Thank you. Let me see... VF88602. I see the order here, delivered 41 days ago. You are right that our return **policy** can be very strict for health and **sanitation** reasons, especially with products that have direct skin contact.
Oh no. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. I was really hoping for some help.

Please hold on one moment while I confirm the specific policy for your VeloBand GPS Tracker... Okay, I have good news. While some of our newer devices have a more limited return window, your product is covered by our 10-day satisfaction guarantee. You are still unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank you! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried. Thank you, Sarah.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated that return for you. I've sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. That's so easy. Thank you again for your help.
Of course. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
No, that was everything. You've been wonderful.
Glad to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
